problems: House of Jagiellon (1450-1569, dynasty) overlaps Kingdom of Poland, Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. I wrote it as 1450 merge of the two kingdoms and a 1569 merge into polish-lithuanian-commonwealth, but Cliopatria's Commonwealth row starts 1572, so 1570-1571 is an unfilled handover. The orchestrator must decide how the three dossiers reconcile.

Cliopatria dates losses late: the Jagiellon shapes of 1497, 1507 and 1516/1519 show Moscow gains years after the page-dated events. I kept page dates in the ledger and used shape years only for keyframes.

Margraviate of Moravia: Cliopatria draws Moravia only 1385-1414 and otherwise inside Bohemia or Hungary. I added no new keyframes; whether to draw it outside those years as a vassal tint is an orchestrator decision.

Suzerain-side vassal entries are needed in other groups' ledgers: Bohemia (vassal_start of duchy-of-bytom 1289-01-10 and duchy-of-raciborz 1327), the Ottoman Empire (Eastern Hungarian Kingdom as vassal from the Ottoman side, me-10), Duchy of Prussia, Livonian Conference, Courland. My dossiers carry only the Jagiellon-side halves.
